active_sprint.name: PB-02_TO_G1_SYSTEM_FREEZE
active_sprint.completion_target: Close G1 electrical envelope and unblock G2 without allocating U1-SCH-R001 early.

tasks.title: Mission, payload and MTOW envelope
tasks.acceptance: Payload, estimated empty mass, battery mass, MTOW min/nom/max, flight duration and environment are defined or explicitly marked as assumptions.
tasks.remaining: PB-02 freezes 85 kg nominal payload, <=80 kg operating-empty mass budget and 150/165/180 kg MTOW targets. Battery/structure/fixed-equipment mass allocation, mission time and environment remain open.

tasks.title: Rotor architecture trade study
tasks.acceptance: Rotor count, hover thrust per rotor, maximum thrust per rotor and thrust margin are numerically defined.
tasks.closure_note: PB-02 freezes X8 coaxial, 8 independent channels, 0.85 coaxial sizing factor, >=1.6 static T/W, 26.471 kgf max-MTOW isolated-equivalent hover point and >=43 kgf isolated max-thrust capability.

tasks.title: Heavy-lift propulsion market benchmark
tasks.acceptance: At least two current motor/propulsion candidates have source-backed thrust, power, voltage and current operating data.
tasks.closure_note: Acceptance satisfied by multiple current heavy-lift/agricultural propulsion references including source-backed operating curves. Product operating-point closure continues in UAV-004.

tasks.title: Motor and propeller operating-point selection
tasks.acceptance: Hover and max-thrust operating points are selected with motor speed, input power and current.
tasks.remaining: PB-02 freezes the 56x20 / 45KV / 18S performance class and source-backed sizing points. Sprint S1 now uses that bounded class to close phase-current and PWM evidence while exact production motor/propeller MPN and final environment/altitude correlation remain open.

tasks.title: Battery voltage and energy architecture
tasks.acceptance: Cell series count, bus min/nom/max, pack current, energy, sag and disconnect behavior are defined.
tasks.remaining: 18S, 66.6 V nominal and 75.6 V full-charge targets are frozen. Sprint S1 must close pack Ah/Wh, minimum loaded voltage, sag, reserve, pack current and disconnect behavior for the rated 18S product.

tasks.title: ESC electrical envelope
tasks.acceptance: Continuous/peak DC power/current, phase RMS/peak current, overload duration, eRPM and transient voltage are frozen from propulsion evidence.
tasks.remaining: PB-02 freezes DC-side >=70 A continuous, >=200 A/3 s peak, >=4.8 kW continuous, >=11.5 kW/3 s short-duration, >=60 keRPM controller capability and <=120 V repetitive stress. Sprint S1 now closes phase-current, PWM, sense-range and remaining protection/thermal parents.

tasks.title: Faz2 Faz3 and B1 keep-recalculate-replace review
tasks.acceptance: Every critical legacy design decision is classified and linked to a current requirement/evidence.
tasks.remaining: Major legacy power, sensing, control, safety and interface blocks are classified; PB-02 frozen decisions must be kept synchronized in traceability while final closure still depends on remaining G1/G2 choices and page-level U1 migration.

tasks.title: Power semiconductor and topology trade study
tasks.acceptance: Device voltage class, switch count, conduction/switching loss, hot RDS, SOA and transient margin are calculated.
tasks.remaining: Voltage class >=150 V is already frozen. Exact MPN/count remains blocked from final closure until phase-current/PWM/thermal parents freeze; bounded exact-part prework is part of Sprint S1.

tasks.title: PWM frequency and current-ripple study
tasks.acceptance: PWM frequency is selected using motor inductance, switching loss, ripple, control bandwidth and acoustic considerations.
tasks.remaining: Sprint S1 performs the system-level PWM/ripple/loss closure needed by G1; final G2 implementation remains blocked until the exact power-stage choice.

tasks.title: MCU and gate-driver architecture selection
tasks.acceptance: MCU and gate driver are selected with PWM/ADC timing, trip latency, current-sense and voltage compatibility evidence.

tasks.title: Current sensing design closure
tasks.acceptance: Shunt value, pulse/continuous power, gain, bandwidth, ADC range, calibration and hardware trip thresholds are proven.

tasks.title: DC-link, precharge and regenerative energy design
tasks.acceptance: Capacitance/ripple/ESR/life, precharge, BMS disconnect and overvoltage energy path are closed.

tasks.title: Thermal model and cooling architecture
tasks.acceptance: MOSFET, shunt, DC-link and PCB/baseplate losses have nominal/hot/worst-case temperatures and derating limits.

tasks.title: Protection and fault tree/FMEA
tasks.acceptance: Failure modes, detection mechanism, hardware response, firmware response and safe-state policy are documented.
tasks.remaining: Structural prework exists. Sprint S1 may close system-level threshold/timeout requirements, but final architecture and physical response evidence remain G2/G4/G6 work.

tasks.title: Create UAV schematic revision
tasks.acceptance: Candidate B1 pages are migrated only after KEEP/RECALCULATE/REPLACE review; critical TBDs are eliminated.
tasks.remaining: Future U1 page map and migration rules are defined, but hardware_u1 remains intentionally uncreated and U1-SCH-R001 unallocated until AR-001 and AR-002 become PASS.

tasks.title: Close production-intent BOM and footprints
tasks.acceptance: All populated critical components have exact MPN, datasheet-backed footprint and derating evidence.
tasks.remaining: Candidate matrix exists; production selection remains blocked by G1/G2 and U1 schematic creation.

tasks.title: Create buildable firmware tree
tasks.acceptance: Reproducible build, board support, PWM/ADC, driver, CAN, fault manager and automated tests exist.

tasks.title: Implement motor-control bring-up path
tasks.acceptance: Low-voltage open-loop, current loop, rotor position/observer and FOC/SVPWM test modes are available.

tasks.title: Control PCB final design
tasks.acceptance: Placement/routing is complete, zero unrouted, critical analog/digital and interface review is closed.

tasks.title: Power PCB / bus structure design
tasks.acceptance: Power loops, gate loops, Kelvin paths, current sharing, thermal path and mechanical current paths pass review.

tasks.title: Manufacturing package and DFM
tasks.acceptance: Gerber, drill, BOM, PnP, assembly/fab notes and DFM evidence are complete.

tasks.title: Low-energy hardware bring-up
tasks.acceptance: Rails, reset, MCU, gate-driver, fault inputs and PWM inhibit are verified before power switching tests.

tasks.title: Switching and protection validation
tasks.acceptance: Gate/switch-node waveforms, overshoot, dead-time, current sense and hardware-trip latency are measured at staged voltage/current.

tasks.title: Dyno / guarded prop stand validation
tasks.acceptance: Hover, continuous and peak operating points are demonstrated with thermal and electrical telemetry.

tasks.title: UAV integration and flight-test readiness review
tasks.acceptance: Propulsion evidence, arming/failsafe, interface, harness, thermal and configuration-control review are complete before flight.
